chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū Ayyūb, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever seeks refuge with a people and they acknowledge his wilayah, then his inheritance belongs to them, and his blood-money liability is upon them.

key_terms.قَوْمٍ: a people or group with whom one aligns himself
key_terms.لَجَأَ: sought refuge or attached himself for protection and affiliation
key_terms.مَعْقِلَتُهُ: his blood-money liability or indemnity obligation
key_terms.مِيرَاثُهُ: his inheritance estate to be inherited after death
key_terms.وَلَايَتِهِ: his acknowledged affiliation, allegiance, or legal association

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person seeks refuge with a people and they accept his affiliation?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a person who attaches himself to a group and they accept his affiliation and wilayah. In that case, mutual legal consequences follow: they inherit from him, and they bear his liability in matters of blood-money.
